highlights.title: Amazon and Google Win Big From Anthropic IPO
highlights.description: If you’re looking for a cheaper way of getting exposure to Anthropic than buying the stock directly, consider Amazon or Google. Anthropic’s updated IPO filing on Tuesday shows just how many shares each of those two tech giants will own in Anthropic, along with how much money they’re making on their early investments in the AI firm. highlights.description: If you want proof of the widening gap in sentiment between public and private investors, take a look at the valuations of Anthropic and OpenAI. On Tuesday, Anthropic disclosed it was targeting a valuation of between $1.26 trillion and $1.4 trillion in its upcoming initial public offering. highlights.title: Breaking Down Anthropic's $1.4 Trillion IPO Valuation
highlights.description: Anthropic is preparing to price its initial public offering on November 18, targeting a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion and raising up to $90.4 billion to fund computing capacity for frontier AI models. Bloomberg’s Michael Shepard discusses the deal structure and whether the artificial intelligence sector can be said to have a circular financing dynamic. (Source: Bloomberg)

Cohere's Gomez on $25B Valuation, Growth

ev_autonomous.title: Tesla tuner Unplugged offers to take over Cybertruck production
ev_autonomous.description: Unplugged Performance, the biggest name in Tesla aftermarket tuning, wants to keep the Cybertruck alive. The company publicly offered on Tuesday to take the Cybertruck line off Tesla’s hands, funded by a consortium of investors. It comes just four days after Elon Musk said Tesla would wind down Cybertruck production at Giga Texas around mid-2027, with the truck selling at roughly 12% of the 250,000 units a year Tesla planned for. more…
